reason: I am planning an expansion this year and my brand has to look like we are worth trusting before anyone walks in. A free first look costs me one comment, so I would take it to see whether they understand a small business like mine.
objection: A free look is easy to give and easy to skip. I have been burned by agencies that show a nice deck and then send a bill I cannot afford, and a pretty carousel does not tell me whether they know how a lodge or a clinic actually gets customers.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing two or three past clients in my kind of business, with real before and after results and not just their logos, would make me want a paid quote.
